segment: train (2003-05-05 to 2020-02-08), already examined by experiments 1-3
counts_note: signals with room for the time stop; no outcome read

detector.dedupe: one signal per pair of peaks (first close through the neckline)

main_setting.entry: market, next candle's open (ask to buy, bid to sell)
main_setting.costs: Dukascopy bid/ask; 1-minute path decides stop/target order, stop first inside a minute
main_setting.controls: study control pools (random market entries, same stop-size bucket, direction, NY session, volatility, year)

criteria: Benjamini-Hochberg q < 0.10 over the tests run, edge > 0
mean R > 0 with p < 0.05 at the Dukascopy spread
mean R > 0 at the user's $0.30 round-trip spread
edge > 0 when entered one candle later
deflated Sharpe > 0.95 counting every trial of experiments 1-4
interpretation: Training data has been examined before (experiments 1-3), so passing every criterion makes a TRAINING CANDIDATE only. Confirmation needs unused data: the sealed final test (separate approval) or forward paper trading. Failing means no evidence of an edge in 17 years of training data.
